- **输入参数**: `{ props: { modelValue?: boolean, title?: string, headerActions?: ComponentConfig[], footerActions?: ComponentConfig[] } }`
- **调用示例**:
```json
{ "type": "r-dialog", "props": { "title": "编辑", "modelValue": true }, "children": [] }
```

### `r-drawer`
> 抽屉容器，支持头部动作、底部动作和 24 列 Grid 内容区
- **输入参数**: `{ props: { modelValue?: boolean, title?: string, headerActions?: ComponentConfig[], footerActions?: ComponentConfig[] } }`
- **调用示例**:
```json
{ "type": "r-drawer", "props": { "title": "详情", "modelValue": true }, "children": [] }
```

### `r-form`
> 表单容器，绑定 DataView.currentRow 实现双向编辑，子字段组件通过 CONTEXT_DATA 读写表单值
- **依赖能力（consumes）**: `PAGE_DATASET`
- **提供能力（provides）**: `DATA_SOURCE`, `CONTEXT_DATA`, `FIELD_CONTEXT`
- **输入参数**: `{ dataKey: string }`
- **调用示例**:
```json
{ "type": "r-form", "dataKey": "Users@currentRow", "children": [] }
```

### `r-list`
> 列表容器，通过 DataKey 绑定 DataView.rows，按卡片/列表重复渲染子字段组件
- **依赖能力（consumes）**: `PAGE_DATASET`
- **提供能力（provides）**: `DATA_SOURCE`
- **输入参数**: `{ dataKey: string, props: { columns?: number, gap?: number|string, rowKey?: string, gridColumns?: number, gridGap?: number|string, gridAutoRows?: string, toolbar?: ComponentConfig[], itemActions?: ComponentConfig[] } }`
- **调用示例**:
```json
{ "type": "r-list", "dataKey": "Users@rows", "children": [{ "type": "r-text", "name": "name" }] }
```

### `r-section`
> 分组块容器，支持标题、描述、折叠和 24 列网格布局；r-block 为其别名
- **输入参数**: `{ props: { title?: string, description?: string, collapsible?: boolean, defaultCollapsed?: boolean } }`
- **调用示例**:
```json
{ "type": "r-section", "props": { "title": "基本信息" }, "children": [] }
```

### `r-steps`
> 步骤容器，内部使用 r-step 定义步骤；当前步骤内容区采用 24 列 CSS Grid
- **输入参数**: `{ props: { modelValue?: string|number, toolbar?: ComponentConfig[] } }`
- **调用示例**:
```json
{ "type": "r-steps", "children": [{ "type": "r-step", "props": { "title": "步骤一", "name": "s1" }, "children": [] }] }
```

### `r-table`
> 数据表格容器，通过 DataKey 绑定 DataView，自动渲染行数据，支持当前行高亮、多选、分页
- **依赖能力（consumes）**: `PAGE_DATASET`
- **提供能力（provides）**: `DATA_SOURCE`
- **输入参数**: `{ dataKey: string, props: { border?: boolean, stripe?: boolean, highlightCurrentRow?: boolean } }`
- **调用示例**:
```json
{ "type": "r-table", "dataKey": "Orders@rows", "props": { "border": true, "highlightCurrentRow": true } }
```

### `r-tabs`
> 标签页容器，内部使用 r-tab-pane 定义面板；每个面板内容默认采用 24 列 CSS Grid
- **输入参数**: `{ props: { modelValue?: string|number, toolbar?: ComponentConfig[], toolbarPosition?: 'top'|'bottom'|'left'|'right' } }`
- **调用示例**:
```json
{ "type": "r-tabs", "children": [{ "type": "r-tab-pane", "props": { "label": "基本信息", "name": "base" }, "children": [] }] }
```

### `r-tree`
> 树形数据容器，绑定 DataView 渲染嵌套树结构，支持懒加载、节点点击、展开/折叠事件
- **依赖能力（consumes）**: `PAGE_DATASET`
- **提供能力（provides）**: `DATA_SOURCE`
- **输入参数**: `{ dataKey: string, props: { nodeKey?: string, lazy?: boolean } }`
- **调用示例**:
```json
{ "type": "r-tree", "dataKey": "departments@rows", "props": { "nodeKey": "id" } }
```
